title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theatre on 1986-04-19
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC (2 Discs Audio / 1 Disc FLAC)
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) D

ai_review.summary: Mixed performance with a heavy Playing in the Band but uneven moments and no clear recording info
ai_review.review: The show is noted for its short length and a powerful, late‑era heavy rendition of Playing in the Band that showcases Jerry’s intense lead work. However, reviewers also hear Jerry “crumbling” and a band trying to hold it together on tracks like Stagger Lee, Crazy Fingers and China Doll. No details about the source or sound quality were provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give an average of ~2.3 stars; positive remarks focus on a single standout jam while negative comments highlight broader performance issues, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewers commented on sound quality or source type.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert runs just over two hours, with a notably short second set; tension is felt throughout as the band seems to be holding together despite some shaky moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mixed feedback – one reviewer says he’s “crumbling,” while another praises his intense lead work and ‘going off’ during jams.
